change: The fork, unchanged: campfire-oncrack:app rebuilt from HEAD, no source change
description: First measured onCrack dot: the F# port as forked, built as campfire-oncrack:app, 3 reps of all five workloads at 1 and 16 connections, server on CPUs 0-3 and load generator on 4-7. It carries one change the port made after its final measurement: unit 7.5 turned thread-pool hill climbing off in the image (59ee9ae), so c=1 reads 2-6% under the stored port numbers, as the port's own unit 7.5 tier 3 did. Nothing onCrack-specific has been changed yet.
